items.title: 68252_Jay Cee
items.q: of the shows I worked with J. C. on -- and we did four

ctx.x: I know, there's something so beautiful about that song.

The unfortunate part about the whole thing was that -- of the shows I worked with J. C. on -- and we did four -- we never had good management. They were either racketeers in the legitimate sense or underworld, because both

of them would manage and produce the shows, but they were only worried about profit, not artistic endeavor. And we gave them hits, but they were too big for them, much too big because since then, when we were in Europe, when we were in London -- that's before the Beatles dug us and got the beat from us and brought it over here and made $17 million (inaudible), but that's what happened.
